communityGuidelines.title: Community Guidelines
communityGuidelines.subtitle: Creating a Safe, Supportive Space for Everyone
communityGuidelines.introduction: Nidal Alrouh is built on principles of mutual respect, compassion, and solidarity. These guidelines ensure our community remains a safe space for peer support and connection.

coreValues.title: Our Core Values
values: Compassion: We treat each other with kindness and understanding
Respect: We honor diverse perspectives and experiences
Support: We offer encouragement without judgment
Privacy: We protect each other's confidentiality and anonymity
Solidarity: We stand together in our shared experiences

peerSupport.title: Peer Support, Not Professional Advice
peerSupport.critical: IMPORTANT: This is a peer support community, not a professional healthcare service.
rules: ✅ Share your personal experiences and what helped you
❌ Do NOT prescribe treatments or medications
❌ Do NOT replace professional therapy or medical care
peerSupport.emergency: If you or someone else is in immediate danger, contact emergency services: 141, 19, or 0801 00 47 47

respectfulCommunication.title: Respectful Communication
guidelines: Be Kind: Use supportive language, avoid harsh criticism
Listen Actively: Read posts carefully before responding
Stay on Topic: Keep discussions relevant and helpful
No Judgment: Everyone's journey is different
Cultural Sensitivity: Respect Morocco's diverse cultural contexts
Language: Use appropriate language (Arabic, French, or English)

privacy.title: Privacy & Confidentiality
rules: Do NOT share others' personal information
Do NOT screenshot or share content outside the platform
Respect anonymous posts - do not try to identify users
Do NOT share identifiable details about others without consent
privacy.yourPrivacy: Use our anonymous posting feature if you want to share without revealing your identity.

prohibited.title: Prohibited Content
prohibited.intro: To maintain a safe community, the following content is strictly prohibited:

harmful.title: Harmful Content
items: Instructions or encouragement for self-harm or suicide
Graphic descriptions of self-harm or violence
Content that could trigger or harm others
Pro-ana, pro-mia, or other content promoting eating disorders

medical.title: Inappropriate Medical Content
items: Suggesting others stop taking prescribed medication

harassment.title: Harassment & Hate
items: Hate speech based on race, religion, gender, etc.

misleading.title: Misleading Information
items: False claims about credentials or expertise

contentWarnings.title: Content Warnings
contentWarnings.description: When sharing potentially triggering content, please use content warnings:
examples: [CW: Suicidal thoughts] - for discussions of suicide
contentWarnings.purpose: This allows others to choose whether to engage with potentially triggering content.

reporting.title: Reporting Violations
reporting.howTo: If you see content that violates these guidelines:
steps: Click the 'Report' button on the post or comment
Our moderation team will review within 24 hours
reporting.emergency: For immediate safety concerns, also contact emergency services.

consequences.title: Consequences of Violations
consequences.policy: We take violations seriously to protect our community:
levels: First Offense: Warning and content removal
Illegal Content: Reported to authorities as required by law
consequences.appeal: You may appeal moderation decisions by contacting support@nidal-alrouh.ma

selfCare.title: Self-Care Reminders
tips: Take breaks from the platform when needed
Use content warnings to protect yourself
Engage at your own pace - no pressure to participate
Seek professional help when community support isn't enough
Remember: peer support complements, but doesn't replace, professional care

resources.title: Professional Resources
resources.intro: When you need more than peer support:
contacts: Crisis Support Page: Visit our dedicated crisis support section for comprehensive resources

communityGuidelines.footer: These guidelines may be updated. We'll notify you of significant changes. Thank you for helping create a safe, supportive community.

codeOfConduct.title: Code of Conduct
codeOfConduct.subtitle: Our Commitment to a Respectful Community
codeOfConduct.pledge: As members of the Nidal Alrouh community, we pledge to make participation a harassment-free experience for everyone, regardless of age, body size, disability, ethnicity, gender identity, level of experience, nationality, personal appearance, race, religion, or sexual orientation.

positive.title: Examples of Positive Behavior
items: Being respectful of differing viewpoints and experiences
Focusing on what is best for the community
Showing empathy and compassion towards others

unacceptable.title: Unacceptable Behavior
items: Any conduct which could reasonably be considered inappropriate

responsibilities.title: Moderator Responsibilities
responsibilities.description: Community moderators are responsible for clarifying standards and taking appropriate action in response to unacceptable behavior.
responsibilities.rights: Moderators have the right to remove, edit, or reject content that violates this Code of Conduct, and to ban temporarily or permanently any member for behaviors deemed inappropriate, threatening, offensive, or harmful.

codeOfConduct.scope: This Code of Conduct applies to all community spaces, including posts, comments, private messages, and community events.

enforcement.title: Enforcement
enforcement.process: Instances of unacceptable behavior may be reported to moderators. All complaints will be reviewed and investigated promptly and fairly. Moderators are obligated to maintain confidentiality regarding the reporter of an incident.

codeOfConduct.attribution: This Code of Conduct is adapted from best practices in online mental health communities and tailored for the Moroccan context.
